title: Smoke barriers.
officialText:
A listed smoke damper designed to resist the passage of smoke shall be provided at each point where a
duct or an air transfer opening penetrates a smoke barrier wall enclosure required to have smoke and draft control doors in
accordance with the New York City Building Code. Smoke dampers and smoke damper actuation methods shall comply with
Section 607.5.4.1.
Exceptions:
1. Smoke dampers are not required in smoke barrier penetrations where the openings in ducts are limited to a single
smoke compartment and the ducts are constructed of steel.
2. Smoke dampers are not required in ducts where the air continues to move and the air-handling system installed is
arranged to prevent recirculation of exhaust or return air under fire emergency conditions.
